policy: Research-only global scoped evidence corrections and seven closer inventory roles. Same rules in all 2000 cases. No new interests invented; unknown is not Yes. All new roles have null interest correlation pending a measured occupational vector; list after existing ranked supported careers, preserving existing Top ranks. Median pay is context only, never starting-pay lifestyle coverage.

rules.reason: The concrete circuit fact explicitly traces a failed connection and records repeatable tests. General design preference is not a separate requirement of this diagnostic-method question.
The question permits documents OR interviews OR survey evidence. The concrete policy fact gathers and compares evidence; numerical preference is not mandatory.
Conflicting historical accounts and original-record provenance support the documentary alternative. Field excavation is not required for every route.
A direct positive daycare-care item plus child-focused activity, organization and safety replace the inappropriate medical patient-care proxy.
The concrete child-game fact already includes watching a response and adapting the explanation. This child-development activity does not require medical patient care.
